_description: Searches Twitter/X for public posts from Indian creators signalling monetization, course launches, or build-in-public activity. Run daily at 6am IST alongside Instagram scrapers. Results feed into Airtable with source=twitter.
_runSchedule: daily at 6am IST — rotate 2 search queries per day
_n8nWebhook: Set Apify actor webhook to POST to your n8n 'Apify → Airtable' flow URL
_searchRotationNote: Rotate through the queries array in n8n. Each day pick 2 queries. This avoids hitting rate limits and spreads signal discovery.

_searchTermDetails.signal: Creator publicly sharing revenue numbers — direct ICP fit signal
Running or promoting a cohort — strongest product signal
Coach sharing their journey publicly — high engagement, likely course
Referencing student count — active seller signal
High-demand creator with full cohorts — premium ICP

_n8nFilterLogic._enrichmentNote: After dedup check, n8n should cross-reference twitter_handle against existing Airtable leads. If handle exists, update twitter_handle field only. If new, create lead record with source=twitter and enqueue for IG profile lookup to find ig_handle.
